messages:
sam_cs: Customer reported 403 on generation and embeddings after we rotated their service token. Customer: guest-tenant-42. They can list models but any call to /v1/generate or /v1/embeddings returns 403. Request ID: r-9c3a2f5b. Need help triaging.
maya_support: Can you paste a curl repro and the full response body? Also which key type (svc token / api key / sso)?
sam_cs: It's a service token created by our provisioner for SSO guest orgs. Repro: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer svc_XXXXXXXX" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/generate
```
Response: 
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
{ "error": "insufficient_permissions", "message": "missing scope: generation" }
```

lin_eng: thanks. Can you also try embeddings endpoint? We want to confirm scopes list. sam, can you grab the token introspect info (claims) from the auth service? provisioner-bot should log creation event.

provisioner-bot: svc token created for tenant guest-tenant-42 by provisioner v2.7.1. granted_claims: ["embeddings"]
(note: trailing comma in CSV import may have caused truncation)

maya_support: aha. The created token only shows embeddings, no generation/rerank. That would explain generate 403. Any recent changes to the provisioner? @nora_oncall tagging infra.

nora_oncall: I'm looking at the provisioner job run from last night. Found CSV import step: the SCIM CSV line for guest-tenant-42 had an extra trailing comma after claims column which our parser treats as empty field and drops subsequent scopes. Example line: `guest-tenant-42,svc,embeddings,` -> parser returned ["embeddings"] instead of ["embeddings","generation","rerank"]. Working on patch.

lin_eng: Can we hotfix for this tenant? We should create a new token with full claims and rotate immediately. sam, can you request a new svc token and test? Use this admin CLI to repro: `redwoodctl tokens create --tenant guest-tenant-42 --claims generation,embeddings,rerank`.

sam_cs: created new token svc_new_ABC123 and tested. generation + embeddings both succeed now. Customer confirmed they are unblocked.

maya_support: Great. Root cause: CSV import/trailing-comma bug in provisioner caused claim truncation. Action items: 1) patch parser to ignore trailing commas (lin), 2) run backfill for tokens created between 2026-03-01 and 2026-03-15 (nora), 3) notify affected tenants (sam). I'll open a KB note.

lin_eng: putting up PR with test and patch, target deploy today. :+1:

provisioner-bot: deploy job queued for provisioner v2.7.2 with CSV parser fix.

sam_cs: closing ETA with customer and sending postmortem summary. Thanks everyone. :party:
